title.zh: 肉鳍鱼类来源限定证据

description.en: Open the Explorer at Sarcopterygii to inspect the linked, locator-bearing source claim together with this package's current occurrence context. This is a reproducible evidence entry point, not a phylogenetic result or a complete history of the group.
description.zh: 在探索器中打开肉鳍鱼类，结合本包当前的出现记录背景检查带有精确来源定位的关联声明。这是可复现的证据检查入口，不是系统发育结果，也不是该类群的完整历史。

limitations: The linked claim retains its own specimen, stratum, model, confidence and source-locator boundaries. The Explorer route does not establish an exact origin, global first or last appearance, direct ancestry, causal mechanism or package-specific phylogeny.

description.en: Open a source-bounded Sarcopterygii time window in the map to inspect sampled occurrence context linked to this package.
description.zh: 在地图中打开有来源边界的肉鳍鱼类时间窗口，检查与本包关联的采样出现背景。

limitations: The interval follows the linked package range and claim; map markers are sampled records and do not establish a complete distribution, exact origination or extinction, or direct ancestry.

title.zh: 四足动物过渡证据比较

description.en: Compare Tiktaalik and Elpistostege through package-linked claims and bounded occurrence context; this side-by-side route is an evidence inspection aid.
description.zh: 通过本包关联的声明与限定出现背景比较提塔利克鱼与希望螈鱼；并列页面仅用于证据检查。

limitations: The two sides retain separate source, sampling, range and uncertainty boundaries; visual differences are not tests of evolutionary causation or a package-specific phylogeny.

title.zh: 提塔利克鱼弗拉姆组体型样本

description.en: Open the approximately 375 Ma Fram Formation window for the named Tiktaalik material to inspect the body-plan claim at its Daeschler et al. locator. The map age follows the documented formation sample, not a global Tiktaalik duration.
description.zh: 打开约 375 Ma 的弗拉姆组窗口，检查具名提塔利克鱼材料及 Daeschler 等论文定位的体型声明。地图年龄遵循已记录的组级样本，而不是 Tiktaalik 的全球存续期。

limitations: The route is bounded to the approximately 375 Ma Fram Formation material and the cited anatomical mosaic. It does not identify a direct ancestor, prove habitual terrestrial walking, establish a global FAD/LAD, or co-register a specimen with a map marker.

title.zh: 提塔利克鱼胸鳍解剖窗口

description.en: Inspect the same approximately 375 Ma Tiktaalik occurrence window through the pectoral-fin study: wrist-like joints and load-bearing inference remain evidence about a ray-bearing fin, not a recorded free-digit limb or walking trace.
description.zh: 通过胸鳍研究检查同一约 375 Ma 的 Tiktaalik 出现窗口：腕状关节与承重推断仅涉及仍保有鳍条的鳍，并非已记录的自由指肢或行走遗迹。

limitations: This age route shares Tiktaalik's formation-bounded range claim; the fin study is a separate anatomical and functional interpretation. It does not observe behaviour, convert the fin into a terrestrial limb, establish global distribution, or show exact specimen-to-map co-location.

description.en: Open a 377 Ma point within the Miguasha Frasnian envelope for articulated specimen MHNM 06-2067 and its CT-based digit or putative-digit interpretation. Retained lepidotrichia keep this evidence distinct from a free-digit limb.
description.zh: 在米瓜沙弗拉斯期窗口内打开 377 Ma 点，检查关节相连标本 MHNM 06-2067 及其基于 CT 的指或可能指解释。保留的鳍条使该证据与自由指肢明确区分。

limitations: The Frasnian envelope contextualizes one named Miguasha specimen and an analysis-dependent homology interpretation. It is not a global genus range, direct-ancestor claim, behavioural observation, complete distribution, or exact map co-registration.

description.en: Open a 365 Ma point within the East Greenland Famennian window to inspect the limb material documenting eight forelimb digits. The count tests a primitive-pentadactyl assumption; it is not an observation of terrestrial walking.
description.zh: 在东格陵兰法门期窗口内打开 365 Ma 点，检查记录前肢八指的肢体材料。该计数检验原始五指假设，并非对陆地行走的观察。

limitations: The route is a stage-level context for the described East Greenland limb material. It does not supply a global FAD/LAD, a direct ancestor, complete geographic coverage, observed locomotion, or a precise fossil-marker overlay.

title.zh: 鱼石螈关节活动模型窗口

description.en: Open a 365 Ma point within the East Greenland Famennian envelope for the reconstructed Ichthyostega specimens and the comparative joint-mobility model. The model constrains feasible motion; it does not record behaviour or represent every early tetrapod.
description.zh: 在东格陵兰法门期窗口内打开 365 Ma 点，检查重建的鱼石螈标本及比较关节活动模型。该模型约束可行运动，不记录实际行为，也不代表所有早期四足动物。

limitations: This stage-level route provides occurrence context for named reconstructed specimens and a model-dependent range-of-motion result. It does not establish observed walking, universal early-tetrapod locomotion, direct ancestry, global range, or exact map co-location.

title.zh: 晚泥盆世四足形类综合背景

description.en: Open a 375 Ma point within Clack's Late Devonian transition-study window to inspect a systematic synthesis alongside the separately locator-backed Zachełmie trace claim. This route keeps footprint evidence, body specimens and phylogenetic explanation distinct.
description.zh: 在 Clack 晚泥盆世转型研究窗口内打开 375 Ma 点，结合独立带定位来源的扎赫乌米耶遗迹声明检查系统综述。该路线将足迹证据、身体标本与系统发育解释保持分离。

limitations: The map age belongs to Clack's Late Devonian synthesis window, not to a Zachełmie locality marker. The Polish traces identify neither a named body taxon nor a direct ancestor; neither source establishes a complete range, global FAD/LAD, behavioural observation, or exact spatial co-registration.
